title: VCs will make billions on Anthropic's IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more | TechCrunch
summary: According to the S-1, Amazon holds convertible notes with $6.2 billion in principal outstanding as of June 30. Amazon’s notes could convert into as many as 1.84 billion shares, according to the S-1.
